content.text:
Perfect! All 255 tests pass. Credit notes are now fully implemented with:

- **createCreditNote(invoice, { amount, reason, date }, existingNumbers)** that:
  - Creates refund credit notes for issued/partially_paid/paid invoices only (NOT_ISSUED for draft)
  - Validates: amount must be positive integer (AMOUNT_INVALID), date format valid (DATE_INVALID), amount ≤ invoice total (CREDIT_TOO_HIGH)
  - Returns `{ number, invoiceNumber, customerId, amount, reason, date }`
  - Credit note numbers use CN prefix with their own per-year counter (separate from invoices)
  - Format: CN-YYYY-CCCC (same pattern as INV-YYYY-CCCC)
  - Handles mixed INV and CN numbers in existingNumbers array

- **23 comprehensive tests** covering:
  - All invoice statuses (issued, partially_paid, paid)
  - All validation errors
  - Numbering logic and per-year counters
  - Separate invoice/credit note counters
  - Mixed number handling
  - Year boundaries
  - Edge cases (large amounts, empty reasons, multiple credits per invoice)
